# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/sapiens
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/sapiens

## File: facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine/device/utils.py

Prompts

```
['get the currently available device type returning cuda, npu, mlu, mps, or cpu', 'get the maximum GPU memory allocated in megabytes for a given cuda device', 'check if cuda devices are available on the current system', 'check if Ascend NPU devices are available on the current system', 'check if MPS devices for Mac M1 chips are available on the system']
```

Usage

```
{'get_device': 'get the currently available device type returning cuda, npu, mlu, mps, or cpu', 'get_max_cuda_memory': 'get the maximum GPU memory allocated in megabytes for a given cuda device', 'is_cuda_available': 'check if cuda devices are available on the current system', 'is_npu_available': 'check if Ascend NPU devices are available on the current system', 'is_mps_available': 'check if MPS devices for Mac M1 chips are available on the system'}
```
